mapper.select: select date_format(order_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, round(sum(amount), 2) as turnover, count(*) as validOrderCount from orders where status = 5 and order_time >= #{begin} and order_time < date_add(#{end}, interval 1 day) group by date_format(order_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by date
select date(create_time) as date, count(*) as newUserCount from user where create_time >= #{begin} and create_time < date_add(#{end}, interval 1 day) group by date(create_time) order by date
select count(*) from user where create_time < date_add(#{end}, interval 1 day)

select date_format(order_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, count(*) as totalOrderCount, sum(case when status = 5 then 1 else 0 end) as validOrderCount from orders where order_time >= #{begin} and order_time < date_add(#{end}, interval 1 day) group by date_format(order_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by date

select od.name as name, sum(od.number) as number from order_detail od join orders o on od.order_id = o.id where o.status = 5 and o.order_time >= #{begin} and o.order_time < date_add(#{end}, interval 1 day) group by od.name order by number desc limit 10
